stories.title: La Inteligencia danesa alerta que Rusia lanzará ataques híbridos más frecuentes contra la OTAN

en.title: Danish Intelligence warns Russia will launch more frequent hybrid attacks against NATO
en.summary: Denmark's defense intelligence service warns that Russia will intensify hybrid warfare in coming months with more frequent attacks against NATO and the West, potentially causing greater damage than previous incidents. The Danish defense minister describes the situation as grave and says it is being taken seriously.

stories.title: Junts aprovecha el desahucio de Maricarmen para sentar al PSOE a negociar el decreto de vivienda

en.title: Junts leverages eviction case to push PSOE to negotiate housing decree
en.summary: The Socialist Party and Junts resume negotiations to advance a housing decree that minority coalition partners have demanded from Pedro Sánchez for months, with the government responding to pressure from allies threatening to reconsider their role in the cabinet.

stories.title: Macron ve posible un ataque ruso en Francia como el de Leipzig

en.title: Macron sees a Russian attack on France like Leipzig as possible
en.summary: France's president warns the country must prepare for potential Russian attacks similar to the Leipzig incident and accuses Moscow of multiplying hostile and criminal actions.

stories.title: La CIA alerta de un ataque ruso con drones contra España, Francia o Italia

en.title: CIA alerts of Russian drone attack against Spain, France or Italy
en.summary: European governments have received a CIA report warning of potential Russian drone attacks on European nations. Russia could reportedly launch Gerbera drones from ships with a range of 600 kilometers, according to Lithuanian government intelligence.

stories.title: La Junta Electoral Central endurece los requisitos para poder votar con la 'ley de nietos'

en.title: Central Electoral Board tightens requirements for voting under the 'grandchildren law'
en.summary: Spain's Central Electoral Board has adopted stricter requirements for those naturalized under the 'grandchildren law' to vote, now requiring documented proof of local residency where they wish to register. This implements a Supreme Court order from June.

stories.title: La Junta Electoral rechaza revisar de oficio las nacionalizaciones dadas por la ley de nietos

en.title: Electoral Board Rejects Reviewing Naturalizations Granted by Grandchildren Law
en.summary: Spain's Electoral Board validated instructions from the Census Office regarding how voters must document their registration in a municipality for voting purposes.

stories.title: La Junta Electoral endurece los requisitos para que los nacionalizados por la 'ley de nietos' puedan votar

en.title: Electoral Board Tightens Requirements for Grandchildren Law Naturalizations to Vote
en.summary: Spain's Electoral Board increased documentation requirements for those naturalized under the grandchildren law, requiring copies of identification, birth certificates, death certificates, and residency records to demonstrate connection to a voting district.

stories.title: Zapatero recusa a la joyería Yanes en un intento de impedir que realice una nueva tasación de las joyas

en.title: Zapatero challenges Yanes jeweler in bid to prevent new valuation of jewels
en.summary: The defense argues that the firm's experts cannot conduct an objective analysis after its director general publicly stated the seized jewels were worth approximately two million euros.

stories.title: Junts regresa a la negociación con el Gobierno para aprobar este martes un decreto que evite desahucios como el de Maricarmen

en.title: Junts returns to negotiations with Government to approve decree preventing evictions like Maricarmen's
en.summary: Puigdemont's party is willing to discuss with the executive based on proposals previously submitted to Pedro Sánchez regarding housing protections.

stories.title: El relator de la ONU para Vivienda reprocha a la jueza no haber suspendido el desahucio de Maricarmen

en.title: UN housing rapporteur criticizes judge for not suspending Maricarmen's eviction
en.summary: The UN official stated that any eviction risking homelessness should be halted until local or regional authorities provide a viable alternative housing solution.

stories.title: Dinamarca alerta de un posible ataque ruso contra un país de la OTAN en los próximos meses

en.title: Denmark Warns of Possible Russian Attack Against NATO Country in Coming Months
en.summary: Danish intelligence services indicated that Russia could potentially conduct an aggression using long-range weapons against critical infrastructure in neighboring NATO countries.

stories.title: Junts admite negociaciones con el Gobierno sobre vivienda y le traslada sus exigencias tras el desahucio de Maricarmen

en.title: Junts admits negotiations with Government over housing and conveys demands following Maricarmen eviction
en.summary: Junts confirms it is negotiating housing policies with the Government and has submitted proposals after months of stalled talks.

stories.title: Plantan a Netanyahu durante su discurso en la Asamblea General de la ONU

en.title: Netanyahu Walked Out On During His Speech at UN General Assembly
en.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's address to the UN General Assembly was marked by the departure of numerous representatives when he began speaking.

stories.title: EQT encarga a JPMorgan la venta de Parques Reunidos por más de 1.700 millones

en.title: EQT hires JPMorgan to sell Parques Reunidos for over 1.7 billion
en.summary: Swedish venture capital firm EQT is preparing to divest from the Spanish leisure park operator, which is also held by Corporación Financiera Alba and GBL as minority shareholders.

stories.title: El taxi le gana la batalla a Cabify y le arrebata el contrato para el transporte de RTVE

en.title: Taxi wins battle against Cabify and takes RTVE transport contract
en.summary: Traditional taxi services have secured a transport contract previously held or sought by ride-hailing platform Cabify for Spain's public broadcaster RTVE.

stories.title: Trump y Xi prometen "colaboración" en IA, comercio y trabajar en un "futuro mejor"

en.title: Trump and Xi promise "collaboration" on AI, trade and working toward a "better future"
en.summary: The US President receives the Chinese President at the White House as both countries extend their tariff truce to allow space for trade negotiations.

stories.title: El Ibex pierde los 19.600 puntos con los tipos de los bonos disparados

en.title: The Ibex loses 19,600 points with bond yields surging
en.summary: Market uncertainty stems from Trump-Xi discussions, oil prices exceeding 100 dollars, and rising debt interest rates, causing the Spanish index to decline.
